verdict.rationale: Cline has no documented region or residency selector. Instead it offers indirect control over where data goes: you can run local models via Ollama or LM Studio, bring your own provider keys (cloud or local), and 'switch providers or self-host anytime', so a user can keep data on their own machine or with a provider they choose. Missing for 10: an explicit data-residency or region-selection setting, documentation of where Cline's own provider and accounts store data, and independent corroboration of residency guarantees.
